origin: United Autosports emerged from the shared passion of Richard Dean and Zak Brown, two individuals with a deep love for motorsport and a desire to create a competitive force in endurance racing. Founded in 2009, the team initially focused on historic racing before expanding into modern GT and prototype categories. Their early years were marked by ambitious entries into prestigious events like the Spa 24 Hours, laying the foundation for future success. A pivotal moment came with their increased involvement in LMP3 racing, which became a cornerstone of their program and a proving ground for talent.
philosophy: United Autosports operates on a philosophy of relentless improvement and a commitment to nurturing talent. They approach car development with a data-driven methodology, focusing on maximizing performance through meticulous preparation and driver feedback. The team culture is built on camaraderie and a shared pursuit of excellence, fostering an environment where every member is empowered to contribute to the overall success.
achievements: European Le Mans Series LMP3 Championship victories
Asian Le Mans Series LMP3 Championship victories
Multiple class wins at prestigious endurance races like the Gulf 12 Hours
Successful forays into LMP2 racing, showcasing their ability to compete at a higher level

teamPrincipal.name: Richard Dean
teamPrincipal.background: Richard Dean brings a wealth of racing experience, both as a driver and a team manager. His hands-on approach and dedication to developing young talent have been instrumental in United Autosports' growth.

keyFigures.name: Zak Brown
keyFigures.description: Zak Brown, a prominent figure in motorsport marketing and management, provides strategic direction and commercial expertise to the team.

keyFigures.name: Jacob Greaves
keyFigures.description: Jacob Greaves oversees the technical aspects of the racing program, ensuring optimal car performance and reliability.

headquarters: United Autosports is based in Leeds, UK. While the facilities are functional, they prioritize investment in on-track performance and personnel over lavish infrastructure.
fanBase: United Autosports has cultivated a loyal fanbase through their consistent success and engaging social media presence. Fans appreciate their commitment to showcasing emerging talent and their competitive spirit on the track.
